definition: Veo, or Google Veo, is a text-to-video model developed by Google DeepMind and announced in May 2024.
details: As a generative AI model, it creates videos based on user prompts. Veo 3, released in May 2025, can also generate accompanying audio.

explainer.lead: Veo is a text-to-video model from Google DeepMind, announced in May 2024. It matters because it generates video directly from user prompts.

tiers.eli5: You type a description and the model produces a short film of it.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers use Veo to generate video from prompts; Veo 3, released in May 2025, can also generate accompanying audio. A pitfall is expecting audio from earlier versions, which lack that capability.
tiers.paperLevel: A generative AI model that creates videos from user prompts. The audio-generation capability applies only to Veo 3.

explainer.example: A prompt describing a sunset over a city produces a matching generated video clip.
